sentences.text: This Criminal Original Petition has been filed to quash the final report in C.C.No.10837 of 2024 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate-I, Salem, as against the petitioner, filed for the offences under Sections 120B, 419, 420, 170, 365 read with 34 and 109 of IPC.
2. The petitioner is ranked as A20 in the final report.
According to the learned counsel for the petitioner there is no material as against the petitioner.
Therefore, he prays to quash the final report.
3. A perusal of the entire final report and statements recorded from the witnesses shows that serious charges have been slapped against the accused including conspiracy.
The accused have made the defacto complainant to bring Rs.50 lakhs to a certain place under the pretext of giving 33% extra money.
Thereafter, one of the accused waylaid the defacto complainant's car and acted as police and taken away the amount Rs.50 lakhs from the defacto complainant.
4. In this case, serious allegations have been made with regard to concrete charges against the accused which could be unearthed only after investigation.

This Court, while exercising its jurisdiction under Section 528 BNSS, cannot conduct a roving enquiry or mini trial as held by the H o n ' b l e S u p r e m e C o u r t i n G u n m a l a S a l e s P r i v a t e L i m i t e d v . A n u M e h t a https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 28/10/2025 07:50:12 pm ) and others reported in (2015) 1 SCC 103, with regard to the veracity of the statements.
5. As far as the charge of conspiracy is concerned, it is settled law that there cannot be any direct evidence.
The charge of conspiracy can be proved by various circumstantial evidence.
The facts can be seen only after the entire evidence come on record and it is the domain of the trial Court to appreciate all the materials which comes before the Court.
Therefore, this Court is not inclined to quash the final report.
6. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed.
Consequently, the connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
